channel.title: Covering Katy News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Covering Katy News (coveringkaty.com)

item.title: Covering Katy News Endorses JJ Clemence for Fort Bend County Clerk in March 3 Republican Primary
item.description: Covering Katy News endorses JJ Clemence for Fort Bend County Clerk in the March 3 Republican primary, citing her experience, character and the disqualifying conduct of opponent Tamara McFarlane.

item.title: EDITORIAL: Smears and Fear: Disproving the McFarlane Deceptions
item.description: There is a long and ugly tradition in American politics of turning the routine into the sinister. The McFarlane campaign has apparently decided that tradition is worth reviving in Fort Bend County.

item.title: Familiar Face: Clothed by Faith appoints Deysi Crespo as executive director
item.description: Clothed by Faith has appointed Deysi Crespo as its new executive director as the faith-based nonprofit marks serving more than 165,000 individuals since its founding.

item.title: Voting locations for Katy's three counties, Fort Bend, Harris and Waller
item.description: Voters in Harris County casting ballots in Tuesday's Republican or Democratic primary will face a multi-page ballot followed by numerous propositions at the end.

item.title: North Katy to Get Restaurants, Shops and Outdoor Plaza at The Green at Katy Park
item.description: KATY, Texas (Covering Katy News) — A groundbreaking ceremony is planned for April at The Green at Katy Park, a new 46-acre shopping and dining destination coming to the northwest corner of Morton Road and Katy Hockley Cutoff Road. It will be across the street from the H-E-B shopping center and Katy Park.

item.title: John Cornyn, Ken Paxton advance to runoff to be Republican nominee for U.S. Senate
item.description: Texas Republicans are in for another three months of mudslinging between Attorney General Ken Paxton and U.S. Sen. John Cornyn after the two bitter rivals advanced to a May 26 runoff in Tuesday’s primary.

item.title: Cantrell defeats Smith for Pct. 4 commissioner GOP nomination
item.description: Waller County Fire Marshall Brian Cantrell defeated former Katy City Council Member Dan Smith Tuesday for the GOP nomination for Waller County Pct. 4 Commissioner, according to unofficial results from the Waller County Elections Office.

item.title: Beckendorff defeats Davis for Waller County judge GOP nomination
item.description: Justin Beckendorff, the Waller County Pct. 4 commissioner, won the GOP nomination for Waller County judge Tuesday, defeating businessman Brian Davis.

item.title: Harris County Election Results
item.description: Democratic and Republican primaries for Harris County Judge and two U.S. House seats will head to runoffs after no candidate secured a majority of votes Tuesday, according to unofficial results.

item.title: Fort Bend County Primary Election Results
item.description: Fort Bend County voters headed to the polls Tuesday for the Republican and Democratic primaries, with Republican Daniel Wong winning the County Judge race outright while Democrat Dexter McCoy is headed to a runoff against Rachelle Carter.
